infrastructureTypes.name: bic_road

infrastructureTypes.description: Streets designated for bicycles.

infrastructureTypes.name: cycleway
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Cycleway
infrastructureTypes.description: Cycleways are dedicated cycling infrastructure that is physically separated from streets. Unlike bicycle lanes on sidepaths, they do not need to run parallel to a street.

infrastructureTypes.name: cycleway_multiuse
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Cycleway multiuse
infrastructureTypes.description: Cycleways that can also be used by pedestrians, mofas and mopeds. Cycleways are dedicated cycling infrastructure that is physically separated from streets. Unlike bicycle lanes on sidepaths, they do not need to run parallel to a road.

infrastructureTypes.name: cyclist_waiting_aid
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Cyclist waiting aid
infrastructureTypes.description: Places where cyclists should wait at a traffic light with the possibility to rest a foot or arm on while waiting at the traffic light.

infrastructureTypes.name: pedestrian
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Mainly/exclusively for pedestrian
infrastructureTypes.description: Streets and areas mainly or exclusively meant for pedestrians.

infrastructureTypes.name: pedestrian_with_bic_allowed
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Mainly/exclusively for pedestrian with bicycle allowed
infrastructureTypes.description: Streets and areas mainly or exclusively meant for pedestrians, where it's also allowed to ride a bicycle.

infrastructureTypes.name: crossing
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Crossing (bicycle, pedestrian, horserider)
infrastructureTypes.description: Crossings of streets for cyclists, pedestrians and horseriders.

infrastructureTypes.name: path_with_bic_forbidden
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Path with bicycle forbidden or unsuited
infrastructureTypes.description: Path that is not designated for pedestrians and cycling is either forbidden or not suitable.

infrastructureTypes.name: uncategorized
infrastructureTypes.displayName: Uncategorized
infrastructureTypes.description: Infrastructure elements that cannot be categorized in one of the buckets. Mainly crossings that are by definition meant for both pedestrians, cyclists and horseriders.
